text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've spent three years with
Matikanefukukitaru. It was long in
essence, and yet, the time went by in a
flash. Today, everything comes to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know what, Trainer? We sure had
the
happiest of times. On top of that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is just the perfect time to wrap
things up!
Getting to finish with a New
Year's shrine visit is
just perfect!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right! We're always on the same page,
always in
sync—like dancers or
synchronized swimmers.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's get praying. Now, let me
find some
money for the offering box...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, arghhhhh! I don't have any change
on me!
Trainer, please lend me a few
coins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is still the same as 
ever—always causing a fuss, but
endearing to the
point you just can't
fault her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I place my hands together and wish for
her
continued success.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What did you pray for? You can tell me.
Just
whisper it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair! Why can't you tell me?
Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, I choose to be an open book!
There's only
one thing I want, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My wish is for you to receive lots of
good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru only has one wish.
And that
wish is for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I also wish for you to tell me what you
wished for!
